prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='best_per_horizon_by_validation'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves the highest seasonal correlation (0.3325) while catboost dominates overall RMSE (60.64) with perfect trend tracking (1.0). The extreme RMSE spread (28.17) and divergent early/late specialists (rf at 32.71 vs catboost at 74.11) indicate horizon-specific selection is optimal. Concept drift and autocorrelated residuals suggest avoiding simple averaging in favor of per-horizon validation-based selection.
